body: CHECK MAINLINE-011b: the arithmetic reproduces. My own scripts (arcs.py not run) match 951 numeric fields (48 RESULTS rows, the 36-row table, 15 named numbers) to 3e-12, and all 169 mode labels. There are no mismatches. Confirmed: the smeared triangulated stiffness (nu 1/3, Et (2/sqrt3)EA/s, D (3sqrt3/4)EI/s, hence sqrt(3/2); Buchert 1968 prints the same), the global pressure (116,990 Pa), Perry, the mass closure, and both SiC rows (1.22552794688, 1.10810389922). The 50 kg systems and margin 0 match the brief (CARD-011, COMMON P3). At 100 kg and 5% margin the same model gives 1.151 and 1.041. Objections are NFI rows and stop nothing. (1) Demonstrated, conservative: on the frame the card counts, statics fix the mean member force at pRs/(2sqrt3), 562 kN at s 2.04 m, not the 974 kN that 022 and 023 use (exact virial identity; geodesic truss solves agree within 1%). With FIX-A, SiC is 1.408. (2) Demonstrated from the cited source, optimistic: local keeps gamma 1 at r/t 140, where SP-8007 gives 0.529, so local is 0.648 at the point. Re-optimised with FIX-B, SiC is 1.075. With both fixes it is 1.205, and 1.130 at 100 kg and 5%; the two-way grid falls to 0.967 with FIX-B alone. (3) Asserted: the global mode presumes moment-rigid joints, which binds 023. Text: the k 0.5 rows are in RESULTS.json only, and INPUTS.json carries no material sources. Every value is QUESTIONABLE; nothing here is a certification.
